releases.title: RPCortex v2.00-beta (build 483)
releases.summary: The v2 beta, replacing the August pre-release: sealed Wi-Fi passwords, curl with all of v1's flags, a package loader that no longer trusts the numbers in a file, and console input that no longer drops characters.

added: Saved Wi-Fi passwords are sealed under a per-device key, and the registry, user list and device key are closed to non-admin accounts.
`curl` takes all of v1's flags, the shell understands single quotes as v1's did, `update` takes `--yes` and `--force`, and idle logout and `pulse boot` work as in v1.
A crash report is saved to flash at the next start.
Over-the-air updates keep a rollback copy of the running firmware; three updates in a row (476 to 479, 479 to 481, 481 to 483) were confirmed on a Pico 2 W.
changed: Smaller images on the RP2350: the Pico 2 W image went from 1009 KB to 855 KB.
Only the shell's task reads the console, so background packages no longer take keystrokes.
fixed: The package loader no longer believes the numbers in the file: fuzzing found four faults in it, including an unchecked relocation offset that was a write wherever it pointed.
Pastes of up to 2,000 bytes and passwords typed at the login prompt arrive whole.
Package versions with a suffix (`1.0-beta`) are no longer reported as newer than themselves.
limitations: The Pico 2 and both RP2040 images (Pico, Pico W) have never run on hardware.
Restoring a saved rollback copy and Bluetooth have only been tested on the host.

The boot recovery ladder does not work in this build: after repeated failed starts it should load nothing, then restore the saved firmware, but its failure count was overwritten before it was read, so it never triggers. Fixed in the next release.
HTTPS needs about 45 KB of free memory.
A saved rollback copy takes 854 KB of the Pico 2 W's 1792 KB filesystem; the next update removes it to make room.
A filesystem was twice seen to read 100% full with a saved firmware copy on it (`rm /os/rollback.img` fixes it); the cause is not found.
